title: Validation of a Novel, Non-Dimensional Approach for Estimation of Pressure Gradients in Aortic Stenosis
brief_summary: A novel, image-based model for estimation of the pressure gradient across stenosed aortic valves is compared against invasively measured pressure gradients from clinical routine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* aortic valve stenosis
* treatment via TAVI
study_population: \- retrospective acquisition of patients that receive TAVI
